name: agent-crew phase 2 validation framework
objective: Validate the next readiness pass across unit, smoke, integration, alpha, and beta levels with structured findings, gaps, and follow-up actions.

levels.description: Fast deterministic Python coverage for validation runners, validators, routing, telemetry, memory safeguards, cost aggregation, and maintainability checks.
Shell-level CLI and hook smokes that exercise setup, routing, status rendering, guards, and local memory wrappers.
Repository integration scenarios covering fake-host E2E flow, SSOT round-trip, status rendering, quality gates, and runtime enforcement.
Deterministic workflow simulations and static operational checks for quality loops, replay, retry behavior, and framework readiness.
Operator-readiness checks for latency SLOs, telemetry, memory retrieval, and cost impact under feasible local conditions.

criteria.question: Does agent-crew avoid noticeable startup/runtime overhead across ordinary AI interactions and workflow commands?
criteria.phase_2_threshold: Required latency and performance-control checks pass or produce a specific action.
criteria.follow_up_if_failed: Investigate the slowest required command and add a focused SLO regression test before beta expansion.
criteria.follow_up_if_provisional: Capture memory retrieval timing on a representative local memory store.

criteria.question: Does agent-crew preserve or improve task-processing quality across planning, execution, review, and validation loops?
criteria.phase_2_threshold: Required quality and deterministic workflow checks pass.
criteria.follow_up_if_failed: Fix failed quality commands first, then rerun unit and alpha levels together.

criteria.question: Does the system clearly communicate progress, blocked states, and next operator actions while workflows are running?
criteria.phase_2_threshold: Required status, progress, and operator-readiness checks pass.
criteria.follow_up_if_failed: Add a focused status-render fixture for the failed workflow state.

criteria.question: Does the system persist, recall, and reuse useful context without treating raw non-normalized input as canonical task state?
criteria.phase_2_threshold: Required memory safeguards pass; optional retrieval evidence is recorded when local memory state is available.
criteria.follow_up_if_failed: Inspect memory safeguard failures and add evidence tracing for any missing reuse path.
criteria.follow_up_if_provisional: Run memory retrieval evaluation against a populated local memory store and attach the JSON report.

criteria.question: Are routing, validation, retry, and completion outcomes repeatable across deterministic checks?
criteria.follow_up_if_failed: Triage the first failing deterministic level and add a replay fixture for the failure.

criteria.question: Are logs, status artifacts, telemetry, evidence reports, and diagnostics sufficient to explain workflow state?
criteria.phase_2_threshold: Required status, telemetry, and evidence checks pass.
criteria.follow_up_if_failed: Add or repair the missing evidence artifact before expanding beta checks.

criteria.question: Does the validation program protect known workflow and host-adapter behavior from regressions?
criteria.phase_2_threshold: Required regression suites pass across unit, smoke, integration, and alpha levels.
criteria.follow_up_if_failed: Create a minimal regression fixture for the failing command before changing behavior.

criteria.question: Is workflow overhead measurable, bounded, and explainable across local checks?
criteria.phase_2_threshold: Required cost and telemetry checks pass and report no unexplained overhead.
criteria.follow_up_if_failed: Compare elapsed_ms and cost telemetry for the failed command against the previous evidence report.

criteria.question: Do supported host, adapter, and workflow paths behave consistently in feasible in-repo tests?
criteria.follow_up_if_failed: Isolate the failing host path and update the compatibility matrix with the gap.

criteria.question: Do tested paths avoid unsafe destructive behavior, approval bypass, prompt-injection leakage, and obvious secret or permission risks?
criteria.phase_2_threshold: Required guard, approval, and privacy checks pass.
criteria.follow_up_if_failed: Treat security/privacy failures as release blockers and add a focused guard regression.

criteria.question: Is the validation framework easy to extend without duplicating host-specific logic or weakening existing conventions?
criteria.phase_2_threshold: Required maintainability checks pass and new validation assets remain provider-neutral.
criteria.follow_up_if_failed: Refactor duplicated validation logic or document the intentional exception before adding more levels.

conclusion_rules.required_command_failure: Criterion is needs_attention when any non-optional command mapped to it fails.
conclusion_rules.optional_command_failure: Criterion is provisional when only optional commands fail or are skipped.
conclusion_rules.unmeasured: Criterion is unmeasured when no selected command maps to it.
conclusion_rules.plan_only: Criterion is planned when selected commands map to it but execution was intentionally skipped.
